record_title: A degree-23 counterexample to a matrix power-sum conjecture over F2
provenance: Scientific theorem, exact finite verification, literature comparison, and review evidence only.
limitations: The result refutes Conjecture 3 of the cited paper, not its Conjecture 1 or Conjecture 2.
The total-degree-23 minimality statement is for r=2.
The exact counterexample is certified by exhaustive finite computation; no closed-form classification of all multidegrees is claimed.
Originality is to the best of our knowledge; a differently phrased or poorly indexed antecedent remains possible.
